title: Adding subtitles
subtitle: 「加字幕」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？
description: 「加字幕」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？

words.meaning: 加上字幕；加入文字字幕
words.note: 非常接近 adding subtitles。在一般影音、社交媒體和教育內容中，兩者常被非技術性地互換使用。
words.example: Adding captions makes the video easier to follow without sound.
words.exampleZh: 加入字幕後，即使沒有聲音也更容易理解影片。

exercises.original: The editor is adding subtitles so viewers can understand the video without sound.
exercises.zh: 剪輯師正在加入字幕，讓觀眾在沒有聲音的情況下也能理解影片。
exercises.upgrade: The editor is adding captions so viewers can understand the video without sound.

options.explanation: 在一般影音語境中，和 adding subtitles 非常接近。
只是翻譯內容，不代表字幕已加入影片。
是加入標題，不是對話字幕。

exercises.original: We are adding subtitles to every lesson video for accessibility.
exercises.zh: 我們正在為每段教學影片加入字幕，以提高無障礙程度。
exercises.upgrade: We are adding captions to every lesson video for accessibility.

options.explanation: 只有文字稿仍未等於加入字幕。

exercises.original: The social media team spent the afternoon adding subtitles to short videos.
exercises.zh: 社交媒體團隊整個下午都在為短影片加字幕。
exercises.upgrade: The social media team spent the afternoon adding captions to short videos.

options.explanation: 在短影片語境中非常自然。

words.note: 和 adding captions 很接近，但語氣稍偏向「令字幕可供觀眾使用」，而不是強調編輯動作本身。
words.example: The platform recommends providing captions for all instructional videos.
words.exampleZh: 平台建議所有教學影片都提供字幕。

exercises.original: The website encourages creators to add subtitles to all educational videos.
exercises.zh: 網站鼓勵創作者為所有教育影片提供字幕。
exercises.upgrade: The website encourages creators to consider providing captions for all educational videos.

options.explanation: 重點是令字幕成為觀眾可使用的功能。
翻譯本身不等於字幕功能。

exercises.original: Adding subtitles can make online lectures more accessible.
exercises.zh: 提供字幕可以令網上講課更無障礙。
exercises.upgrade: Providing captions can make online lectures more accessible.

options.explanation: 特別自然於 accessibility 語境。

exercises.original: The broadcaster now adds subtitles to nearly all of its online programmes.
exercises.zh: 這家廣播機構現在幾乎為所有網上節目提供字幕。
exercises.upgrade: The broadcaster now provides captions for nearly all of its online programmes.

options.explanation: 強調節目有字幕可供使用。

words.note: 非常精簡的專業表達，指為影片、節目或錄像製作／加入 captions。
words.example: Captioning the interviews took several hours.
words.exampleZh: 為這些訪談影片製作字幕花了幾個小時。

exercises.original: Adding subtitles to the entire interview took three hours.
exercises.zh: 為整段訪談加字幕花了三個小時。
exercises.upgrade: Captioning the entire interview took three hours.

options.explanation: 精簡地表示字幕製作過程。
可能是其中一步，但不完整。

exercises.original: The team responsible for adding subtitles checks every line against the audio.
exercises.zh: 負責加字幕的團隊會把每一行文字與音訊核對。
exercises.upgrade: The captioning team checks every line against the audio.

exercises.original: Automatic tools can speed up the process of adding subtitles.
exercises.zh: 自動工具可以加快製作字幕的過程。
exercises.upgrade: Automatic tools can speed up captioning.

options.explanation: 直接指整個字幕處理過程。

words.note: 最直接的名詞／動名詞式替代，尤其適合翻譯、影視、後期製作語境。
words.example: Subtitling the documentary into English required careful translation.
words.exampleZh: 為這部紀錄片製作英文字幕需要仔細翻譯。

exercises.original: Adding English subtitles to the documentary required careful translation.
exercises.zh: 為紀錄片製作英文字幕需要仔細翻譯。
exercises.upgrade: Subtitling the documentary into English required careful translation.

options.explanation: 涉及把內容轉成另一種語言的字幕時特別精確。
只轉成文字，不代表形成字幕。

exercises.original: The studio hired a specialist to add subtitles to the foreign-language film.
exercises.zh: 製片公司聘請專人為外語電影製作字幕。
exercises.upgrade: The studio hired a specialist to subtitle the foreign-language film.

options.explanation: 動詞 subtitle 可直接表示為影片加入字幕。

exercises.original: Adding subtitles in several languages was the final stage of post-production.
exercises.zh: 以多種語言製作字幕是後期製作的最後階段。
exercises.upgrade: Subtitling in several languages was the final stage of post-production.

options.explanation: 多語言字幕是典型 subtitling 語境。

words.note: 非常直接、自然的口語說法。
words.example: Can you put subtitles on the video before we upload it?
words.exampleZh: 我們上傳影片前，你可以把字幕加上去嗎？

exercises.original: Can you add subtitles to this clip before we upload it?
exercises.zh: 我們上傳這段影片前，你可以把字幕加上去嗎？
exercises.upgrade: Can you put subtitles on this clip before we upload it?

options.explanation: 自然口語說法，意思幾乎完全相同。

exercises.original: We should add subtitles to the video before sharing it online.
exercises.zh: 我們在網上分享影片前應該把字幕加上去。
exercises.upgrade: We should put subtitles on the video before sharing it online.

options.explanation: 只翻譯不等於加入字幕。

exercises.original: They added subtitles to the recording so everyone could follow the conversation.
exercises.zh: 他們把字幕加到錄像上，讓所有人都能理解對話。
exercises.upgrade: They put subtitles on the recording so everyone could follow the conversation.

options.explanation: 直接表達字幕被加到影片上。

words.note: 在字幕本身就是畫面文字的語境中，可以非常接近 adding subtitles。
words.example: We added on-screen text so viewers could read what the speaker was saying.
words.exampleZh: 我們加入螢幕文字，讓觀眾可以讀到講者所說的內容。

exercises.original: The editor added subtitles showing everything the speaker said.
exercises.zh: 剪輯師在畫面上加入文字，顯示講者所說的全部內容。
exercises.upgrade: The editor added on-screen text showing everything the speaker said.

options.explanation: 上下文已清楚說文字呈現講者內容，因此很接近 subtitles。

exercises.original: We added subtitles so people watching silently could read the dialogue.
exercises.zh: 我們加入畫面文字，讓靜音觀看的人可以閱讀對話。
exercises.upgrade: We added on-screen text so people watching silently could read the dialogue.

options.explanation: 因為明確是 dialogue，所以這裡就是字幕功能。

exercises.original: Adding subtitles made the spoken instructions visible on screen.
exercises.zh: 加字幕令口頭指示以文字形式出現在畫面上。
exercises.upgrade: Adding on-screen text made the spoken instructions visible on screen.

options.explanation: 文字就是在畫面上呈現語音內容。

words.note: 很自然的非技術說法。在語境已清楚知道文字是對話字幕時，可以代替 adding subtitles。
words.example: We added text to the video so people could watch it with the sound off.
words.exampleZh: 我們在影片中加入文字，讓人們關掉聲音也能觀看。

exercises.original: They added subtitles so the short video could be understood with the sound off.
exercises.zh: 他們在短影片中加入文字，讓觀眾關掉聲音也能理解。
exercises.upgrade: They added text to the video so it could be understood with the sound off.

options.explanation: 語境已清楚表明這些文字是字幕。

exercises.original: We need to add subtitles before publishing the interview on social media.
exercises.zh: 我們在社交媒體發布訪談前需要加入字幕文字。
exercises.upgrade: We need to add text to the video before publishing the interview on social media.

options.explanation: 在已有訪談和字幕上下文中，非常自然。

exercises.original: The creator added subtitles that appeared in sync with each spoken sentence.
exercises.zh: 創作者在影片中加入文字，並讓它與每句語音同步顯示。
exercises.upgrade: The creator added text to the video that appeared in sync with each spoken sentence.

options.explanation: 同步呈現語音內容使它明確等同字幕功能。
只有翻譯稿未必出現在影片。

falseSynonyms.zh: 轉錄不等於加字幕 transcribing 是把語音轉成文字。 你可以先 transcription，再製作 subtitles；但只有文字稿本身並不代表字幕已放進影片。 我們把訪談轉成文字稿。 我們把字幕加到訪談影片中。
falseSynonyms.point: COMPARE We transcribed the interview. We subtitled the interview.

falseSynonyms.zh: 翻譯不等於加字幕 翻譯字幕內容只是 subtitling 的其中一步。
falseSynonyms.point: The dialogue was translated into English. English subtitles were then added to the video.

falseSynonyms.zh: 加入標籤不等於加字幕 labels 多數用來標示人物、物件、地點或資料，不是逐句呈現對話。
加入標題不等於加字幕 titles 可以是片名、章節名或畫面標題，不等於字幕。
加入文字稿不一定等於加字幕 影片旁邊附上一份 transcript 和把同步字幕放在畫面上，是兩件不同的事。
配音不等於加字幕 dubbing 是用另一段語音取代／覆蓋原本的語音。 字幕是文字，配音是聲音。
